fields.Participants: Director, Facilities & Real Estate, CFO, Budget Analyst (VS-33.1)

workflows.name: Post-Disaster Rebuilding CAPA Budget Approval and Financing Setup

Automation Opportunity: - Automated budget constraint matching on project code creation.
Controls: - CTL-02: Capex authorization limits; Board approval required for rebuilds > PHP 50M.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Rebuilding budget overflow risk**: Project costs exceed budget due to lack of contingency funds; mitigated by adding a mandatory 15% disaster contingency buffer to all reconstruction budgets.

steps.activity: Compile reconstruction budget request: BOQ, contractor estimates, permit fees, contingency buffer.
Verify funding source allocation: insurance recovery offsets vs. corporate CAPEX cash.
Review budget against corporate performance metrics and annual plans.
Release approved project budget in ERP and initialize project code.

fields.Participants: Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Contractor Account Manager, VP Legal (VS-100)

workflows.name: Fast-Track Construction Contractor Vetting and Procurement SLA

Automation Opportunity: - Automated PCAB license verification checks linked to contractor profiles.
Controls: - CTL-06: Prevent unauthorized vendor onboarding; Director approval on procurement agreements.
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal operations), VS-165 (PCAB), VS-116 (surety)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unlicensed contractor risk**: Contractor fails civil works audit due to invalid PCAB/safety accreditation; mitigated by validating credentials directly on PCAB board database (VS-165).
System Touchpoints: - Contract System (VS-100), Vendor Master (VS-29), Surety system (VS-116).

steps.activity: Vet candidate contractors for valid PCAB licensing, insurance coverages, and project capacity.
Draft fast-track construction agreement incorporating milestones, safety penalties, and payment terms.
Review contractor bonding and bank guarantee requirements per VS-116.
Execute contract signing and register contractor in vendor database.

fields.Participants: Contractor Site Manager, Store Manager, Facilities Coordinator

workflows.name: Site Reconstruction PMO Activation and Schedule Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - Automated milestone progression tracking with alert systems.
Controls: - CTL-783: ensure controlled execution — Rebuilding Project Execution & Safety Clearance (PA-184.2). — CAPA budget controls; Director, Facilities & Real Estate approval on schedule baselines.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Milestone tracking lapse risk**: Delays in construction work go unreported, extending store closure; mitigated by enforcing weekly milestone verification checks in PMO database.
System Touchpoints: - Project Management module (VS-112), Store Operations dashboard.

steps.activity: Initialize project milestones in ERP project management tool.
Conduct site kick-off meeting defining milestones (demolition, structure, fit-out).
Establish weekly progress reporting routines and review timelines.
Update project dashboard and share access with Regional Managers.

workflows.name: Rebuilding Site Safety Fencing and Public Access Exclusion

Controls: - CTL-783: ensure controlled execution — Rebuilding Project Execution & Safety Clearance (PA-184.2).; OHS safety standards certification.
Cross-references: - links to VS-24.3 (HSE storage), VS-147 (premises liability)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Public safety incident risk**: Customers or passersby injured by falling construction debris; mitigated by installing overhead protective canopies and physical fences.

steps.activity: Establish continuous 2-meter physical safety fence around construction site.
Position safety warning signs, directional guides, and emergency assembly areas.
Secure site entry gates; restrict access to authorized crews wearing required PPE.
Conduct site hazard briefing for drayage drivers and delivery crews.

fields.Participants: Contractor MEP Engineer, MEP Inspector, Store Manager

workflows.name: Building Systems HVAC Electrical MEP Refurbishment

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "pressure test fire lines" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-783: facilities asset verification evidence retained; Director, Facilities & Real Estate sign-off required.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sprinkler leakage risk**: Improperly installed sprinkler joints leak and damage store inventory after reopening; mitigated by pressure testing water lines at 150 PSI for 24 hours.

steps.activity: Install and wire HVAC ducting, compressors, and building automation controllers.
Install plumbing, grease traps, fire sprinklers, and electrical panels.
Conduct functional load testing of electrical systems and pressure test fire lines.
Sign off MEP system checklist in ERP.

fields.Participants: LGU Building Official, Store Manager, Director, Facilities & Real Estate
fields.Trigger: Construction completion and MEP testing complete (W5285)

workflows.name: LGU Building Official Inspections and Structural Safety Clearance

Automation Opportunity: - Online tracking portal dashboard matching LGU permit statuses.
Controls: - CTL-41: LGU permit compliance controls; VP Store Operations sign-off.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Certificate of Occupancy delay risk**: Reopening delayed due to LGU administrative backlog; mitigated by submitting clearance applications 10 days before final construction handover.

steps.activity: Submit Certificate of Completion and request building inspection from LGU Office of Building Official.
Coordinate site walkthrough inspection with municipal building officials.
Address any building code punchlist items flagged by LGU official.
Secure LGU Certificate of Occupancy and safety clearances.

fields.Participants: BFP Inspector, Store Safety Officer, Director, Facilities & Real Estate

workflows.name: Bureau of Fire Protection BFP FSIC Re-Certification

Controls: - CTL-41: LGU/BFP regulatory compliance controls; Compliance Director verification.
Cross-references: - links to VS-76 (LGU compliance), VS-24.2 (emergency preparedness)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fire code citation risk**: Store shut down by authorities for lacking valid FSIC at reopening; mitigated by conducting pre-inspections matching BFP checklists.

steps.activity: Apply for Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC) at local BFP station.
Coordinate physical testing of fire alarms, smoke detectors, and emergency exits.
Verify that fire extinguisher certification tags are valid and placement is correct.
Secure BFP FSIC certificate and update store permit records.

fields.Participants: Store Manager, Project Manager, Regional Operations Manager

workflows.name: Reconstructed Store Facility Inspection and Commissioning Sign-off

Automation Opportunity: - Handover dashboard with automated contractor payment release routing.
Controls: - CTL-783: ensure controlled execution — Rebuilding Project Execution & Safety Clearance (PA-184.2). — CAPA budget controls; ROM sign-off required.
Cross-references: - links to VS-40 (capex), VS-37 (store opening), VS-109 (remodel)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Retained defect risk**: Contractor paid in full before structural defects are corrected; mitigated by withholding 10% contract value until 30 days post-opening.

steps.activity: Conduct final site punchlist walkthrough (paints, signage, POS, registers).
Verify that all systems are operational: lighting, POS, network, backroom locks.
Execute formal project handover certificate and release contractor retainer.
Update store status to "Ready for Trading" in corporate database.
